statement.zh: 中前古典已具备完备神王制度——证据与定义仍不足以上升为定论。
statement.en: That full divine kingship was already complete in the Middle Preclassic remains definitionally and evidentially unsettled.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: Preclassic divine kingship completeness is interpretive.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only; density pass 3 (D-2026-10-12-2).
